query: UPDATE assistant_sessions a SET state='closed',closed_at=coalesce(closed_at,now()) WHERE a.state='active' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assistant_conversation_sources s WHERE s.workspace_id=a.workspace_id AND s.session_id=a.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM access_tokens t WHERE t.id=a.login_id AND t.expires_at>now())
